pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pUses its glowstone-value ingredient family plus furnace fuel to generate FE.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Provide valid furnace fuel.$p2. Provide an ingredient shown in this extractor’s value recipes.$p3. Keep a receiving buffer available.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pNutrient and burn time are separate resources. A zero nutrient input cannot be repaired by increasing the EU conversion rate.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pProcessing / value recipes: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
